notes.title: DEMO Has Ended!
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/a2321d3eb832163da99def53bcdb7f78ac5d5af7.jpg"][/img][/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Hey Survivors![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]The [b]MIMESIS[/b] [b]demo has officially wrapped, and what a blast it's been![/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Seeing so many of you jump in and enjoy the game was absolutely incredible.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]During the demo, over 660,000 trams set off, and together you all survived for more than 240,000 hours.[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]We’re incredibly grateful for the support, the feedback, and the time you spent with us.[/h3][h3] [/h3][h3]We’re now fully focused on what comes next — and we can confidently say, it’s only going to get better from here.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]And Come to [url="https://discord.gg/6WJvq36rab"]Discord[/url]. We can talk more there.[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Stay tuned.
We’ll be in touch.[/h3]

notes.title: The Terms of Service for MIMESIS have been revised
notes.content:
[list][*][p]The Terms of Service for MIMESIS have been revised.[/p][/*][*][p]The newly added content is as follows:[/p][/*][*][p]For more details, please refer to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/eula/2827200_eula_0"]LINK[/url] [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]20. AI Features and Data Use
a) The Game includes artificial intelligence (“AI”) features that simulate in-game characters, including the main monster “Mimesis.” When you play the Game, you will interact with these AI-powered characters.
These AI features are driven by pre-trained models that generate fixed, predefined responses based on Environmental Data collected during your gameplay. Environmental Data refers to contextual information such as your character’s in-game location, triggered events, sensor readings, and the status of nearby objects. The AI does not update itself, evolve, or learn in real time based on your interactions. However, Environmental Data may be used later in an offline setting to further train or improve the AI models.b) Non-Human Nature and Output Characteristics - The AI system is not a human being and may simulate human-like responses. All character behavior are the result of scripted responses based on static models and predefined logic. These outputs do not reflect the thoughts, views, or intentions of any real person.c) Disclaimer of Liability and User Awareness - All outputs generated by the AI system are coincidental. Any resemblance to real people (living or dead), events, or situations is purely coincidental and unintentional. The Company disclaims all liability for any interpretation, reaction, or reliance based on the AI’s responses. Users must not interpret AI behavior as reflective of real-world facts or opinions, nor attribute intent, judgment, or agency to the AI or its creators. As interactions with AI-driven elements in the Game are based on user discretion, they should be approached with care and without misuse. The Company is not liable for any harm or confusion that may result from misinterpretation or unintended reliance on AI-generated content.[/p]

Improved a rare issue that occurred during tram repairs.[/b][/h3][h3][b]2. Improved a character movement and monster animations under unstable 3. network conditions.[/b][/h3][h3][b]4. notes.title: A basic guide for survivors
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44894022/f7e8ce8c8ea8f4af2d58bb15375823c11fc40dc1.png[/img]

Hello. Survivors.

Welcome aboard the tram, where you've taken refuge from the insane rain - and from the family, friends, and colleagues you once knew.

From now on, I will give you seven essential guidelines for boarding and surviving on this tram.

[h2][b]1. Before Departure [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/12d63e891b8bc1a6770ae51db9358aba6de3d9d1.png[/img]
When the game begins, you will join other survivors at the service station.

If you need any items before boarding, we recommend purchasing them in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/6536e2a098e6474eb2c59aa4431ff029c4c59983.png[/img]
※ Please note that item prices are subject to change without notice, so make sure to check the daily rates.

[h2][b]2. Tram Departure [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/133f8cb1e20c2727377f434ebfade8dd8f47b504.png[/img]
Once you're ready,
please press and hold the lever inside the tram (HOLD E) to depart.

[h2][b]3. Destination Selection[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/74aaed2dc52767cf7c9f0c69bd257f91dfea8a7e.png[/img]
Once the tram departs, you will need to choose your destination.
After selecting your desired destination, pull the lever again to arrive at that location.

[b][h2]4. Exploration [/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/b09632fef42c867534b07c69582517e675dc6334.png[/img]
Upon arriving at your destination, please explore the abandoned area and gather resources.
※ However, your survival is the top priority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/458eb7dca7b43770ba1da286eb57c79b0305f9f9.png[/img]
You can drop collected resources onto the tram floor using the G key.
Even after the tram departs, the resources will be preserved and safely transported to the destination - as long as all passengers do not die.

[b][h2]5. Service Time Information [/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/ad8b01bd7be4d65b12e6a48c311813b3efc9c09a.png[/img]
At midnight, the tram will depart automatically.
However, please remember that you can manually operate the lever to depart at any time before midnight.
※ The timing of departure is a strategic decision for survival. Choose wisely.

[b][h2]6. Service Station Arrival[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/5e1422f8b813f777913a19a2c90e130ccbaddaa3.png[/img]
After three days, the tram will arrive at the next service station.
Please sell the resources you’ve collected to repair the tram.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/4057759a78ff1c586d6595b6d271b1339c6a21f9.png[/img]
Additionally, shower facilities are provided free of charge and are available for unlimited use.

[h2][b]7. Departure Again[/b][/h2]

Whether the repairs are complete or not, the tram must depart.

Did you leave without fully repairing the tram?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/dbf0f3797ae480fbd21669494a480c5e1a8b2821.png[/img]
Then I will wait for the next group of survivors.

Then, I wish you all a safe survival
and hope to see you again at the next maintenance station.
Stay safe out there.

notes.title: [Survivors Wanted] ‘MIMESIS’ Survivor Test : Day 1
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44894022/637823878b0aaa65a7406d4ebc5b5094f92cc48c.jpg[/img]

ReLU GAMES presents a brand-new cooperative survival game, and you're invited to the closed beta test of "MIMESIS."

[h1][b][MIMESIS: Survivor Test : Day 1][/b][/h1]

1. Application Deadline: By 0:00, June 2, 2025 (PDT)

     [url=https://forms.office.com/r/BP1tVxj6py][Apply for tester][/url]

2. Tester Selection: Testers will be randomly selected from those who apply before the deadline.

3. Test Period: From 0:00, June 4 to 0:00, June 6, 2025 (PDT)

4. How to Participate: On June 3, selected testers will receive [b]4 Steam keys[/b].
    → You can register your key on Steam and play during the test period.
    → One selected tester can invite up to 3 friends — a total of 4 players can join the game together!

MIMESIS is a cooperative survival game where 4 players team up.
If you want to be among the first to experience MIMESIS, [b]apply now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827200/MIMESIS/
